testimonials.name: Kenisha Spriggs
testimonials.text: I had an amazing experience with Global Furniture HTX! From the moment I walked in, the customer service was top-tier — friendly, attentive, and genuinely focused on helping me find exactly what I needed.

testimonials.name: Dewon Pullen
testimonials.text: Great experience with Global Furniture HTX. The quality of the furniture is top tier, prices are fair, and the customer service is solid from start to finish. They made the whole process smooth and stress-free. Definitely recommend if you're looking to furnish your home the right way.

testimonials.name: Darrell Guinn
testimonials.text: I thought the prices was a joke till I got there. I went to Rooms to Go and to furnish my new house it was a lil over 12k. I went here and got the same stuff for not even 25% of what Rooms to Go was charging.

testimonials.name: Carlotte Austin
testimonials.text: I'm happy with my purchases. Terrance was helpful in helping me pick out a mattress for my new bedroom set. Best mattress I've slept on in years. When the guys delivered my furniture they set up my bed and dresser and left no mess behind.

testimonials.name: Nary Spears
testimonials.text: Terence is very professional and knowledgeable about the store products. Adrion made a timely and also a professional delivery. This is the place to go for quality, affordable mattresses.

testimonials.name: Tonya Horn
testimonials.text: I had a great experience with Global Furniture from start to finish. The staff was friendly, knowledgeable and never pushy, making the shopping process stress-free. The selection was impressive — well made pieces at fair prices.

testimonials.name: Lakendra Williams
testimonials.text: I had a great experience shopping at this furniture store. They were knowledgeable about their products and took the time to answer my questions and help me find pieces that matched my style and budget.

testimonials.name: Lakesha Lafayette
testimonials.text: Very professional, fast response and great customer service. My mattress is soooo comfortable!

testimonials.name: Derrick Castex
testimonials.text: Great customer service, prices and prompt same day delivery with reasonable delivery fee.

testimonials.name: Gaylord Hutchins
testimonials.text: I really appreciate this company. I would recommend everyone to try them out. Very professional and on time. Quality of merchandise is awesome.

testimonials.name: Exclusive Collision
testimonials.text: Great Quality! Best prices and service! They delivered and removed my old furniture! I can't recommend enough!!!

testimonials.name: Jaterra Williams
testimonials.text: The only furniture store that I shop at for quality products at a great price — nobody can beat!!

testimonials.name: Porsche Jackson
testimonials.text: I purchased a new mattress and I've been sleeping on cloud 9 ever since. Thank you for your quality service!!

testimonials.name: Nicoloe Lee
testimonials.text: Best prices in Houston. My whole experience was great. Check them out — you will love them.

testimonials.name: Bobby Austin
testimonials.text: Service was on point. The crew set up furniture at a fast pace — great crew.

testimonials.name: Lessie Benion
testimonials.text: Very professional and was a fast install.

testimonials.name: Bj Austin
testimonials.text: Had a great experience at Global Furniture. The salesman was very helpful. Everything was very affordable and delivery was on time.
